differential.name: Chronic kidney disease secondary to hypertension
differential.rationale: Elevated creatinine (1.7 mg/dL) with hypertension and obesity in a 47‑year‑old suggests hypertensive nephrosclerosis progressing to CKD.

differential.name: Iron‑deficiency anemia
differential.rationale: Microcytic MCV (≈40 fL) and low hemoglobin/hematocrit indicate iron deficiency, common in chronic blood loss or poor intake.

differential.name: Obstructive sleep apnea
differential.rationale: Severe obesity (BMI ≥ 40) plus hypertension and daytime stress raise the likelihood of OSA contributing to cardiovascular risk.

differential.name: Non‑alcoholic fatty liver disease (metabolic syndrome)
differential.rationale: Prediabetes, obesity, dyslipidemia (LDL 138 mg/dL, total cholesterol 218 mg/dL) are classic risk factors for NAFLD.

differential.name: Thalassemia trait
differential.rationale: Asian ethnicity with microcytic anemia raises suspicion for a hereditary hemoglobinopathy.
